nodes.q: How do I find a registered tax agent near me?
nodes.a: Complete our 60-second questionnaire with your postcode and needs. We match you with a TPB-registered tax agent whose services fit your needs. You can verify any agent on the public TPB register at tpb.gov.au.
nodes.aText: Complete our 60-second questionnaire with your postcode and needs. We match you with a TPB-registered tax agent whose services fit your needs. You can verify any agent on the public TPB register at tpb.gov.au.

nodes.q: What's the difference between a tax accountant and a registered tax agent?
nodes.a: 'Tax accountant' is a job title; 'registered tax agent' is a legal authorisation under the Tax Agent Services Act 2009. Only a registered agent can charge a fee to lodge returns or represent you to the ATO. All matched firms that lodge returns in our network are registered tax agents.
nodes.aText: 'Tax accountant' is a job title; 'registered tax agent' is a legal authorisation under the Tax Agent Services Act 2009. Only a registered agent can charge a fee to lodge returns or represent you to the ATO. All matched firms that lodge returns in our network are registered tax agents.

nodes.q: Can a tax accountant near me help with an ATO audit?
nodes.a: Yes. Our network includes agents experienced in ATO audits, reviews and disputes. Mention you need audit or dispute support in the questionnaire and we will match you with a firm that handles ATO representation.
nodes.aText: Yes. Our network includes agents experienced in ATO audits, reviews and disputes. Mention you need audit or dispute support in the questionnaire and we will match you with a firm that handles ATO representation.

nodes.q: How much does a tax accountant cost?
nodes.a: Individual returns typically range from $200 to $400; business and complex returns are higher. The matched agent gives you a clear quote after reviewing your situation. The matching service itself is free.

nodes.q: Can a local tax accountant help with investment property and depreciation?
nodes.a: Yes. Our network includes agents who prepare depreciation schedules, handle rental property schedules, and advise on CGT implications when you sell. Mention property or CGT in the questionnaire and we will match you with a firm that specialises in investment property tax.
nodes.aText: Yes. Our network includes agents who prepare depreciation schedules, handle rental property schedules, and advise on CGT implications when you sell. Mention property or CGT in the questionnaire and we will match you with a firm that specialises in investment property tax.

nodes.q: What if I have overdue tax returns as well as a tax agent need?
nodes.a: Tell us in the questionnaire that you have overdue returns. Our network includes registered agents experienced in catch-up work — lodging multiple overdue years, reconstructing records where needed, and requesting penalty remission where mitigating circumstances apply.
